verdict.rationale: Mercury states that its AI reads bills and populates their details so you can approve and pay them, and its send-money docs describe optional approval controls. A 'request to send money' endpoint routes payments through the organization's approval policies, and Gate Disbursements holds queued payments for sign-off before funds are released. Missing for 10: detail on how approval routing is configured (multi-step or multi-approver chains, amount thresholds), first-party docs on the bill upload/intake method beyond a marketing line, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill-pay approval flow.
